actual_policy: Read effective.{days,count,bytes} on the current original manager; defaults are not measured installation policy. Count/bytes may evict records before days.
order: local acceptance sequence, not station timestamp or a total device chronology
delivery: at least once; consumer dedup event.id

reset.reset_cursor: Opaque current high-water mark: explicit consumer acknowledgement accepts discontinuity, never proves old loss delivered

invalid_current_source_cursor: invalid_cursor on malformed/MAC mismatch, no fabricated page
durability: Exact deep page image persisted under original save lock before success; save failure never yields a success cursor. Concurrent arrivals retain their own later sequence.
restart: Same original source/key/positions persist; duplicate page reads possible, never exactly-once.
migration: Original retained rows receive local acceptance positions when old storage lacks durable_resume; pre-migration evicted events cannot be reconstructed. all_delivered is scoped to the saved current source high-water image, never all historical/device events.
